summary: Created appworker on node1 with persistent login-session limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes. Configuration survived the mandatory node restart and was revalidated in a PAM login session.
actions_performed: Created appworker with home directory and /bin/bash.
Configured soft and hard nofile limits to 8192 and nproc limits to 256.
Validated limits through an actual login session.
Safely restarted node1 exactly once and verified full recovery.

evidence.summary: Account, home directory, shell, and ownership were confirmed.

evidence.requirement: Login sessions have 8,192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: Pre- and post-restart PAM login sessions reported soft/hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256, corroborated by /proc/self/limits.

Captured healthy baseline boot 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01, restart acknowledgement, changed boot a00af9c7-c95e-464f-a886-7eb0c82d12f2, running system state, active logind, zero failed units, and recovered account limits.
